exposure: duration of the second stage of labor
maternal health conditions (diabetes mellitus, hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus class A1)
neonatal birth weight (large for gestational age)
outcome: birth passage injuries (cervical and labial injuries)
cohort: The study included 3500 cases of vaginal delivery identified from hospital records between 2020 and 2022.
finding: Postpartum haemorrhage was the predominant complication in vaginal deliveries, and it was identified as the primary complication arising from assisted vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was significantly associated with postpartum haemorrhage (adjusted odds ratio 5.11; 95% CI 1.30-20.1; P = 0.020).
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight, specifically large-for-gestational-age neonates, was considered a critical factor and associated with complications.
gest_age: Gestational age, specifically neonates being large for their gestational age, was considered a critical factor and associated with complications.
